pool_recheck_hint: After {poolRecheckGraceSeconds} seconds of failure, recheck the failed servers and choose from the group again. Pauses when the local network is unavailable. Up to {poolRecheckAttempts} attempts, {poolRecheckFirstRetrySeconds} and {poolRecheckSecondRetrySeconds} seconds apart. Cancel stops automatic retries until you reconnect manually.
after_filters_and_ordering_keep_up_to_th: After filters and ordering, keep up to this many candidates. The startup limit then selects servers from that pool. Changes apply on the next connection.
auto_select_apply_on_reconnect: Saved changes will apply after reconnecting.
auto_select_connection_info: The remembered server is checked before connecting. Changes apply the next time you connect.
auto_select_dialog_description: A fast connection without searching manually.
auto_select_failover_hint: Find another server if the current one is unavailable
auto_select_hint: Find a fast server and switch if it fails
auto_select_hint_connect_only: Find a fast server when you connect
auto_select_reuse_hint: 30m = 30 minutes; 0s disables reuse; maximum {autoSelectReuseHoursMax}h. Reconnecting checks the remembered server first. If it fails, all candidates are checked. Reconnecting does not extend the TTL.
auto_select_source_hint: Searching the list on the right does not limit auto-select.
auto_select_timeout_hint: {autoSelectTimeoutMsMin}ms–{autoSelectTimeoutSecondsMax}s. The same timeout is used for the reconnect check and the full search.
auto_select_unavailable_hint: At least two eligible servers are needed.
checks_all_matching_servers_before_both_: Checks all matching servers before both pool limits, using the pool health URL and the HTTP timeout in settings. Fresh successes and failures are reused. The updated order remains a draft until Save.
choose_library_order_sorting_to_change_t: Choose “Library order” sorting to change the order.
pool_members_hint: Choose up to {maxPoolMembers} servers. The core measures this pool and switches when a member fails. Membership is saved explicitly; update it after adding servers to a subscription.
clear_the_search_and_filters_to_change_t: Clear the search and filters to change the order.
comma_separated_country_codes_empty_all_: Comma-separated country codes. Empty: all countries. Uses the last IP check for the saved server, VLESS core and group proxies. The server and pool must use the same group proxies. With a country filter, servers without a matching measurement are excluded. Run “Check IP and country” in server diagnostics to measure them.
core_starts_with_saved_http_measurements: Core starts with saved HTTP measurements. Their age is preserved; normal health checks continue.
counts_each_time_a_server_was_included_i: Counts each time a server was included in a successfully started pool. History is stored on this device.
delete_saved_startup_history_for_this_po: Delete saved startup history for this pool?
drag_the_handle_or_press_alt_click_the_h: Drag the handle or press Alt+↑/↓. Click the handle to open the menu.
finish_selecting_multiple_servers_to_cha: Finish selecting multiple servers to change their order.
insecure_transport: This server's traffic is not properly protected
keep_eligible_servers_in_the_saved_order: Keep eligible servers in the saved order; append new servers by fresh HTTP delay. Update order uses completed measurements for the candidate pool, before the startup limit. Save applies the draft; Cancel discards it.
keeps_the_current_connection_while_check: Keeps the current connection while checking replacements. Applies the new pool after a successful HTTP check. Up to three attempts; cancelling pauses automatic replacement until you reconnect manually.
measure_and_update_order_before_connecti: Measure and update order before connecting
measure_missing_checks_and_update_order_: Measure missing checks and update order
name_filter_examples_germany_netherlands: Name filter examples: Germany|Netherlands or ^Fast. Filters ignore letter case. To pin a server temporarily, use the running pool diagnostics.
no_duplicates_available_for_removal_in_t: No duplicates available for removal in this selection.
no_matching_servers_yet_you_can_save_thi: No matching servers yet. You can save this pool; connecting will require at least one matching server.
only_identical_configurations_of_the_sam: Only identical configurations of the same type in the same group are compared. Active, selected, favorite and referenced profiles are kept. Subscription updates may add removed copies again.
ordinary_sing_box_xray_profiles_and_expl: Ordinary sing-box/Xray profiles, WireGuard/AmneziaWG endpoints and explicit chains can join this pool.
pinning_here_lasts_until_disconnect_set_: Pinning here lasts until disconnect. Set a preferred server in the profile editor to restore it at connection start.
rebuild_when_every_running_server_fails_: Rebuild when every running server fails
saves_the_average_delay_of_new_core_http: Saves the average delay of new Core HTTP checks on this device. The original check time is kept; paused checks and restored startup hints do not become new measurements. These results can be used by HTTP ordering and saved measurements at the next startup.
servers_can_only_be_reordered_within_the: Servers can only be reordered within the same group.
the_pool_uses_ordinary_sing_box_xray_pro: The pool uses ordinary sing-box/Xray profiles and WireGuard/AmneziaWG endpoints from this group. Subscription changes apply at the next connection, or automatically if enabled below.
updating_the_subscription_restores_the_p: Updating the subscription restores the provider’s order.
build_limit_hint: Use the first N servers after filters and the selected ordering. Up to {maxPoolCandidates} matching candidates are considered. The limit also applies when failed checks remain eligible for retry. Changes apply at the next connection.
uses_completed_http_checks_of_this_pool_: Uses completed HTTP checks of this pool’s health URL with matching server settings and group proxies. Run HTTP latency checks from the server list. TCP/ICMP times are not HTTP measurements. 0 minutes ignores saved results. If every eligible server failed its last HTTP check, they remain eligible for retry. New results apply on the next connection.
wait_for_the_current_operation_to_finish: Wait for the current operation to finish.
when_enabled_connection_waits_for_missin: When enabled, connection waits for missing HTTP checks. You can cancel while the previous connection stays active. The new order is saved after connection succeeds.
selector_order_pool: Retained in the pool: {kept}. New candidates in the pool: {fresh}
selector_pool_cap_count: Eligible before the pool cap: {eligible}. Candidates kept: {kept}. Outside the pool: {omitted}
selector_pool_limit_count: Candidates before the startup limit: {eligible}. Pool candidates outside this startup: {omitted}
selector_limit_count: Eligible before the limit: {eligible}. Not included in this startup: {omitted}
selector_unknown_country_count: Country has not been measured for the current settings: {count}
selector_ranking_summary: Fresh successful HTTP checks: {ranked}. Without a matching fresh result: {unknown}
selector_kept_unavailable: All eligible servers failed their last HTTP check; kept for retry: {count}
maintenance_unavailable_hint: Servers whose last test failed. A server that only failed the outside check is kept.
maintenance_invalid_hint: Servers the core does not accept. Each one is validated before it is listed.
maintenance_insecure_hint: Servers whose traffic is unencrypted or protected by a certificate that is not verified.
maintenance_resolve_hint: Server names are replaced with the address the system resolves them to. A running server keeps its name.
maintenance_none: Nothing to remove in the displayed servers.
maintenance_no_names: No displayed server is addressed by name.
maintenance_kept: Kept: a chain, a route or the connection needs this server.
group_auto_clear: Remove unavailable servers after a test
member_jitter_hint: How much the latency moves around. The pool prefers steady servers over fast but erratic ones.
member_dials_hint: Real connections applications made through this server.
member_note_pinned_unusable: your choice, but not usable right now
member_note_cooldown_in: failed to connect, retrying in {seconds} s
